description: The kill-gate cell: 'moderate degradation' as committed before any trial ran. The gate number is the success rate over this band (D-022 definition; first-attempt and multi-attempt reported separately per D-005), with its confidence interval. Changing this band after any results exist is a recorded revision reporting both numbers.
encounter_geometry: host pitch/roll, view angle, and range marginalize over their full committed distributions (they are encounter geometry, not degradation dials)
system_parameters: all swept system parameters sit at their labeled defaults (INTERFACE_SPEC 9.1)

encounter_geometry_realization.note: D-046(b): the encounter_geometry marginalization made real — uniform over the D-024 attitude envelope; the D-029 band block above is untouched (verbatim transcription preserved). View angle and range remain trajectory-induced.
